In CARB states (CA/NY/ME/etc.)

existingFixParts.component: Front catalytic converter / front exhaust pipe assembly (converter complete) - 2015-2016 2.5L (recall WUJ-95 remedy part

existingFixParts.note: Downstream O2 sensor after the catalyst - a lazy/slow rear O2 can mimic P0420, so verify/replace before condemning the cat. Verified on Subaru catalog for 2013-2017/2019 2.5L (ref 68011561 area) and DENSO 234-4907 direct cross. For 2015-2019 5th gen the alternate downstream PN 22690AB06A is also cat
existingFixParts.component: Rear (downstream) oxygen O2 sensor - rule-out + replacement, 2013-2017 2.5L

existingFixParts.note: Upstream wideband A/F sensor - the fix says compare upstream A/F switching vs downstream O2 to confirm a true catalyst fault; a skewed A/F sensor can also throw efficiency codes. Verified for 2015-2019 2.5L Legacy/Outback (also BRZ). NOTE year-split: 2010-2012 EJ25 uses 22641AA54A (DENSO 234-9097);
existingFixParts.component: Upstream air/fuel ratio (A/F) sensor - diagnostic comparison part, 2015-2019 2.5L

existingFixParts.note: Required consumable - the crush/doughnut gasket at the front-pipe-to-converter (rear) flange must be replaced whenever the pipe/converter is unbolted or you'll get an exhaust leak (which itself can trigger false P0420). existingFixParts.note: No Subaru OEM PN — this is a body-shop refinish consumable. entries.component: subaru anaerobic/rtv seal

existingFixParts.note: THE key part for this repair. Called out by name in Subaru oil-seepage TSB 02-131-12R as the anaerobic/RTV liquid gasket for resealing the FB cam carrier.
